_comment: Isolated data layer for Haarks Intelligence. Every entry is a curated, source-attributed summary written by Haarks; the original reporting belongs to the linked source. This file is the single source of truth; the static cards in /intelligence/index.html mirror it and can later be regenerated from this file by a GitHub Action. No fabricated content: only entries with a verifiable primary source may be added.

trackedEntities.note: Tracked industry entities for intelligence coverage. This is not a ranking and implies no endorsement, partnership, or comparison.

entries.title: FDA finalises guidance on change control plans for AI-enabled devices
entries.summary: The FDA issued final guidance on marketing-submission recommendations for a Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) for AI-enabled device software functions, describing how planned model modifications can be pre-specified, validated, and implemented.
entries.whyItMatters: It affects how AI-enabled medical technologies are evaluated and updated after they reach the market.
entries.haarksRelevance: Context for how AI in medical software is regulated; informational only.

entries.title: FDA updates its public list of AI/ML-enabled medical devices
entries.summary: The FDA maintains and periodically updates a public list of AI/ML-enabled medical devices authorised for marketing in the United States, available as a downloadable file.
entries.whyItMatters: A practical reference for understanding which categories of AI-enabled devices have reached the US market.
entries.haarksRelevance: Reference resource for tracking the medical-AI device landscape.

entries.title: WHO publishes ethics and governance guidance for large multi-modal AI models in health
entries.summary: The World Health Organization released guidance on the ethics and governance of large multi-modal models (LMMs) in health, with recommendations for governments, developers, and health-care providers across the AI lifecycle.
entries.whyItMatters: It outlines widely-referenced principles for responsible use of generative AI in health settings.
entries.haarksRelevance: Aligns with Haarks' source-grounded, human-in-the-loop approach.

entries.title: Intuitive receives FDA clearance for the da Vinci 5 robotic system
entries.summary: Intuitive announced FDA 510(k) clearance for da Vinci 5, its next-generation multiport robotic system, which the company later reported was cleared for certain cardiac procedures.
entries.whyItMatters: Signals continued iteration in multiport surgical robotics platforms available to surgical teams.
entries.haarksRelevance: Part of the surgical-robotics landscape Haarks tracks; informational only.

entries.title: Medtronic's Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system cleared for urologic procedures
entries.summary: Medtronic announced FDA clearance of its Hugo robotic-assisted surgery (RAS) system for urologic procedures, following its Expand URO clinical study; the company later reported the first US surgery with the system.
entries.whyItMatters: Adds another robotic-assisted surgery option in the soft-tissue robotics market.
entries.haarksRelevance: Part of the surgical-robotics landscape Haarks tracks; informational only.

entries.title: Stryker expands its Mako robotics portfolio with handheld robotics
entries.summary: Stryker announced an expansion of its Mako robotics portfolio, introducing a handheld robotics system (Mako RPS) for total knee replacement alongside its robotic-arm platform.
entries.whyItMatters: Reflects diversification of orthopaedic robotic-assistance formats available to surgeons.
entries.haarksRelevance: Relevant to orthopaedic workflows Haarks supports; informational only.
